newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Reuters 8th ex-Moscow air cargo market report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 8th ex-Moscow air cargo market report.

text.p: Below are the current average ex-Moscow air cargo market rates in U.S. dollars per kg for a 100 kg shipment, with a volume-to weight ratio of six-to-one.
These rates exclude any cargo fuel surcharges, which are being applied by foreign airlines.

The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuters journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller air cargo agents based at Moscow's Sheremetyevo international airport.
All prices are quoted in U.S. dollars
The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices and are indicative of current market activity. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 7706
